metadata.title: Syrwa Tdong Masi | Oxtail Stew | Khasi Recipe
metadata.description:
Masi Tdong  Syrwa or Oxtail stew is a delicious Khasi stew recipe that you can enjoy with steamed rice or with your rotis. The meat and bones from the tail part is cooked for a prolonged period with a combination of vegetable to make this delicious dish. In this dish I have made use of carrot and potatoes. Cabbage and beans can also be used to make this dish. 

Ingredients required
Oxtail - 250 gms
Carrot - 1 large size
Potato - 1 medium sized
Onion - 1 medium sized
Ginger - 1 inch piece
Oil - 1 tbsp
Pepper - 1 tbsp
Salt to taste
